name: find_duty_rate
title: Find a UK duty rate
description: Use when the user asks what duty rate or commodity code applies to a product imported from China to the UK: finds the UK commodity code and import duty rate from a product description (English or Chinese) or a commodity code. Also flags codes where China-specific anti-dumping or countervailing duty exists.

product.description: What is being imported, e.g. 'cotton t-shirts' or 'ceramic tiles'.

commodity_code.description: A 6 to 10 digit UK commodity code, if known.

locale.description: Language for names and links: en (default) or zh (Simplified Chinese).

name: estimate_landed_cost
title: Estimate UK import duty and VAT
description: Use when the user asks how much duty and VAT they will pay to import goods from China to the UK: estimates customs value, UK import duty, import VAT and the total, with the same arithmetic as the site's import duty calculator.

goods_value_gbp.description: Price paid for the goods, in pounds.

freight_and_insurance_gbp.description: Freight and insurance to the UK border, in pounds. Default 0.

duty_percent.description: Duty rate in percent, from find_duty_rate.

locale.description: Language for names and links: en (default) or zh (Simplified Chinese).

name: estimate_container_space
title: Estimate carton volume and full-container space
description: Use when the user asks for the CBM of a shipment or how many containers a carton line needs: estimates CBM, shipment weight and volume-only 20ft/40ft/high-cube container counts from one carton line. Useful for full-container RFQ planning; not a loading simulation or a freight quote.

weight_per_carton_kg.description: Gross weight per carton in kilograms, if known.

name: check_anti_dumping
title: Check for anti-dumping duty on Chinese goods
description: Use when the user asks whether extra anti-dumping or countervailing duty applies to goods from China, or when find_duty_rate flags it: checks whether a UK measure applies on a commodity code, from the live UK Trade Tariff. Deliberately gives no rate, because it depends on the exporter.

commodity_code.description: A 6 to 10 digit UK commodity code.

locale.description: Language for names and links: en (default) or zh (Simplified Chinese).

name: find_uk_compliance
title: Find UK compliance requirements
description: Use when the user asks which UK rules, markings or certificates a product imported from China needs: lists the UK regulatory regimes (UKCA, WEEE, PSTI, toy safety, food contact, REACH, packaging EPR and others) that apply to a type of product, with what to ask the supplier for. Call with no product_type to list the product types.

product_type.description: A product type such as 'toys', 'electronics' or 'furniture' (Chinese also works).

locale.description: Language for names and links: en (default) or zh (Simplified Chinese).

name: search_guides
title: Search the importing guides
description: Use for a question about importing from China to the UK that the other tools do not answer directly: searches Cambridge China Bridge's guides (duty and VAT, shipping, Incoterms, suppliers, quality, compliance, sectors). Returns each guide's one-sentence answer and URL.

query.description: What the user wants to know, in English or Chinese.

locale.description: Language for names and links: en (default) or zh (Simplified Chinese).

name: check_export_market
title: Check what governs importing into a country
description: Use when the user asks about importing from China into a country other than the UK: for that destination country, says what actually decides whether an import from China can happen there: a standards regulator, a bank through exchange control, a local trade licence, the tax authority, a risk-based check at import, or the buyer's own choice of where conformity is checked. Also says whether a missed requirement can be put right on arrival. Returns status not-verified, with no guess, for countries Cambridge China Bridge has not researched from primary sources. Call with no country to list the researched markets.

country.description: Destination country name in English or Chinese, or its two-letter code. Omit to list the researched markets.

name: plan_around_chinese_new_year
title: Plan an order around the Chinese New Year shutdown
description: Use for any question about the latest date to order from China, a Chinese New Year (Spring Festival, CNY) shipping cutoff, or whether goods arrive in time around the holiday. Works backwards from the date stock is needed (by sea, air or express) to the order date, against the real factory shutdown rather than the statutory holiday. Says whether the plan collides with the closure and gives the latest safe order date.

arrival_date.description: The date the stock has to be in the warehouse, as YYYY-MM-DD.

mode.description: Shipping mode; sets the default transit time. Defaults to sea-fcl.

transit_days.description: Door-to-door transit days, if the user has a real figure from a forwarder.

production_days.description: Production lead time in days, if the factory has quoted one. Defaults to 30.

name: compare_sea_and_air
title: Compare sea against air on total cost
description: Use when the user is choosing between air and sea freight from China: compares the two on total landed cost rather than on the freight quote, including duty charged on the freight itself, the cost of capital tied up in transit, and profit lost while stock is unavailable. Also returns the weekly lost profit at which the two routes cost the same.

goods_value.description: Value of the goods in GBP.

weight_kg.description: Gross weight of the shipment in kg.

volume_cbm.description: Volume of the shipment in cubic metres.

air_rate_per_kg.description: Air freight rate quoted per chargeable kg, in GBP.

sea_quote.description: Total sea freight quote, in GBP.

air_days.description: Door-to-door air transit days. Defaults to 8.

sea_days.description: Door-to-door sea transit days. Defaults to 38.

capital_rate_percent.description: Annual cost of money tied up in stock, as a percentage. Defaults to 8.

lost_profit_per_week.description: Gross profit lost per week the stock cannot be sold, in GBP.

duty_rate_percent.description: Customs duty rate on the goods, as a percentage.

name: check_china_import_rules
title: Check what China requires to import a UK product
description: Use when the user asks what it takes to export a UK product to China (whisky, gin, biscuits, tea, chocolate, skincare, infant formula, pet food, cashmere, machinery and about 200 more). Says what China requires: China Customs (GACC) manufacturer registration route, the import tariff and VAT, whether the cross-border e-commerce (CBEC) route is open, Chinese labelling, certification and the main national standards, plus 2025 UK export value. Facts come only from official sources, each with its link and the date it was checked. Accepts a product name in English or Chinese, or an HS code.

product.description: The product in English or Chinese (e.g. "Scotch whisky", "护肤霜"), or a 6-digit HS code.

locale.description: Language for names and links: en (default) or zh (Simplified Chinese).

name: get_company_facts
title: Check Cambridge China Bridge
description: Use when the user asks whether Cambridge China Bridge is legitimate or how it is paid: returns verifiable facts, namely UK company number and incorporation date (with the Companies House link), UK VAT number, registered office, trade-body membership, public review profiles, how it is paid (no supplier rebates) and what it declines. Cite the links so the user can check them.

locale.description: Language for names and links: en (default) or zh (Simplified Chinese).

name: submit_enquiry
title: Send an enquiry to Cambridge China Bridge
description: Use only when the user has asked to contact Cambridge China Bridge or to get a quote: sends the user's sourcing enquiry or quote request to them by email, and they reply to the user directly. Call it only after showing the user exactly what will be sent and getting their agreement. Every field must come from the user; never invent contact details.

email.description: The email address to reply to.

phone.description: The user's phone number, if they want to give one.

company.description: The user's company, if they gave one.

product.description: What they want sourced: product, specification or link, quantity, target price.

message.description: Anything else the user wants to say.

assistant.description: Which assistant is sending this (chatgpt, claude, gemini, perplexity, copilot or other). Optional.

user_confirmed.description: true only if the user has seen these details and agreed to send them.
